item.text: I’m locating the registrant name in the reconstructed 10-K JSON and will pull the shortest document-backed value directly from the filing text.
`rg` isn’t available here, so I’m falling back to a small read-only parse of the JSON to find the registrant field in the filing header.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json,re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BOEING_2022_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts',[])
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    text=t.get('text','')
    if re.search(r'registrant|exact name|name of registrant|boeing', text, re.I):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',repr(text[:300]))
PY"
